title: Comparison table
description: Switching emails. Exactly 4 rows; keep each cell under 10 words.
usage: Two-column “us vs them” comparison on charcoal. Left = competitor pain, right = Libre benefit. Locked layout — edit only text.
notes: Stays a two-column table on mobile (no drop), as in the Mobile frame; cell side padding drops from 16px to 10px (mobile-prl; Figma 8).
The 16px column gutter is fixed padding on a spacer cell; Figma narrows it to 8px on mobile but no ADC class gets close without collapsing the gutter.
Mobile: section padding 48/24 snaps to 40 top (padd-top), 30 bottom (mob-pad-bot), 15 sides (pad15); row gaps 24 snap to 20 (himobtop; Figma 16).
The #7B8290 border (border/primary) is left to the inbox in dark mode.
Heading uses f24 (28 → 24) per the convention table; the Figma Mobile frame keeps 28px.
